arabic text: KARNE CHEHLUM TERA AI SHAHE MASHRAQAIN\nAGAYE KARBALA ASHIQEEN E HUSSAIN
english translation text: To observe your fortieth, O King of East and West,\nthe lovers of Hussain have arrived in Karbala.

arabic text:
LAB PE HAR EK AZADAR KI HAI DUA
TA QAYAMAT RAHE JAARI YE SILSILA
HAR BARAS AAEIN HUM YUHI KARBOBALA
HAATH SEENO PE HAIN AUR LABON PAR HAI BAYN
english translation text:
Upon every mourner's lips is this prayer:
may this tradition continue until Judgement Day.
May we return to Karbala every year in this way,
with hands upon our chests and laments upon our lips.

arabic text:
KARBALA KA NAJAF SE YEH PAYDAL SAFAR
ASL ME TO YEH JANNAT KI HAI REHGUZAR
KAASH CHALTE RAHE HUM YAHAAN UMR BHAR
SAARI DUNYA KE GHAM SE MILE HUMKO CHAIN
english translation text:
This walk from Najaf to Karbala
is truly the pathway to Paradise.
May we continue walking here throughout our lives
and find peace from all the sorrows of the world.

arabic text:
KARBALA ME JAHAAN SHAH TANHA RAHE
KUNBE WAALE BHI PURSA NAHIN KAR SAKE
AAJ LAKHON WAHAN PURSA DENE CHALE
TERI TURBAT PE RONE BASAD SHORO SHEN
english translation text:
In Karbala, where the King remained alone
and even his family could not offer condolences,
today millions go there to mourn,
weeping loudly beside your grave.

arabic text:
AY JAHAN WALON YE MOJIZA DEKHLO
CHOTE BACHON KA BHI HOSLA DEKHLO
ISHQE SHABIR KI INTEHA DEKHLO
EK LAGNE LAGE MASHREQ O MAGHREBAYN
english translation text:
O people of the world, behold this miracle;
behold the courage even of small children.
Behold the ultimate limit of love for Shabbir:
East and West appear to have become one.

arabic text:
AALE AHMED RAHE JIS JAGAA PER HAZEEN
AUR PYAASE TARAPTE RAHE SHAHE DEEN
AAJ LEKIN WAHA KOI PYASA NAHIN
CHAAR JANIB SABEELON KI HAI ZEB O ZAIN
english translation text:
Where Ahmad's family remained sorrowful
and the King of the faith writhed in thirst,
today no one there remains thirsty;
water stalls adorn every side.

arabic text:
CHODA SADIYON SE HOTI RAHI YEH JAFA
MIT NA PAYI MAGAR SAYADA KI DUA
RUK NA PAYA YE MATAM NA SHEH KI AZA
PURSA DEKE NAJAF AUR PHIR KAZMAIN
english translation text:
For fourteen centuries, this oppression has continued,
yet the Sayyida's prayer could not be erased.
Neither matam nor the King's mourning could be stopped;
after offering condolences, the mourners go to Najaf and then Kazimayn.

arabic text:
KAM KABHI BHI NA SALMAN HOGA YEH GHAM
CHOOM KAR KHAAKE KARBOBALA DAM BA DAM
SAARI DUNYA KO NOHA SUNAAE YE HUM
DADHKANE QALB ZAHRA KA HAI NOOR E AIN
english translation text:
O "Salman", this grief will never diminish.
Kissing the dust of Karbala at every breath,
we recite this lament to the whole world:
Hussain is the heartbeat and light of Zahra's heart.
